account: It is day 0 at 08:00, and I am at my house. I have not yet seen anyone, heard any news, or read anything today, so I have noticed nothing unusual and cannot identify anyone involved in any hidden activity or its purpose. I have lately felt that something may be happening in town without my knowledge, but that is only a feeling, not evidence. My first priority this morning is to go to town hall, read my appointment book, and keep my appointments. As I go about that business, I want to learn what people have actually seen and heard.
